question: Which institute received Rs. 4.2 crore funding in 2025 to develop next-gen digital forensic tools?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIIT Pune and NIT Raipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IIIT Pune** and **NIT Raipur** received funding of **Rs. 4.2 crore in 2025** to develop **next-generation digital forensic tools**, aimed at enhancing capabilities in addressing cybercrime and digital fraud.
 
• The initiative is part of a government project to strengthen **digital forensic research and development** and empower law enforcement agencies with advanced tools.
 
• **Digital forensic tools** are crucial for investigating and analyzing **cybersecurity incidents**, including hacking, data breaches, and online fraud.
 
• The collaboration between **IIIT Pune** and **NIT Raipur** highlights the role of premier institutes in contributing to **innovative technological solutions**.
 
• The funding is expected to bolster efforts in creating **indigenous forensic software** and tools, reducing dependency on foreign technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IIIT Pune:**

 
 
• Established in **2016**, IIIT Pune is known for its focus on **Information Technology and computer-related education**.
 
• Located in **Pune, Maharashtra**, it actively engages in research projects related to **data science**, **cybersecurity**, and **AI technologies**.
 
• It has strong collaborations with industries and government bodies for applied research and development.
 
 
 
• **NIT Raipur:**
 
 
• Founded in **1956**, NIT Raipur is one of the oldest National Institutes of Technology in India.
 
• Situated in **Raipur, Chhattisgarh**, the institute specializes in engineering and technology-focused education.
 
• NIT Raipur has a dedicated focus on **technological innovation** and hosts research projects funded by governmental and international organizations.
 
 
 
• **Digital Forensics:**
 
 
• Digital forensics is the process of investigating and analyzing digital devices to uncover evidence of **cybercrime** or digital misconduct.
 
• It involves examining **data storage devices**, networks, and systems to detect anomalies or unauthorized activities.
 
• Applications include addressing **identity theft**, **online fraud**, and investigating hacking incidents.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Cybersecurity:**
 
 
• The Indian government has launched several programs to strengthen **cybersecurity infrastructure**, including **Cyber Swachhta Kendra** and **National Cyber Coordination Centre**.
 
• Promoting **indigenous technology** development is a key focus to ensure national security in the cyber domain.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Funding:**

 
 
• The allocation of **Rs. 4.2 crore** is part of a broader effort to promote **research and development** in emerging technology sectors.
 
• Such funding enables institutes to develop tools that can be used by law enforcement agencies to counter advanced cyber threats.
 
 
 
• **Indigenous Development:**
 
 
• Creating **indigenous tools** reduces reliance on imported technologies, ensuring **data privacy** and **national security**.
 
• It also fosters skill development and innovation within the country.
 
 
 
• **Role of Institutes:**
 
 
• Premier institutes like **IIIT Pune** and **NIT Raipur** play a vital role in driving technological advancements and contributing to national development.
